items.headline: Small Craft Advisory issued October 23 at 2:23AM EDT until October 24 at 8:00PM EDT by NWS Melbourne FL
items.description:
* WHAT...For the Small Craft Advisory, northeast winds 20 to 30
knots and seas 5 to 8 feet expected. For the Gale Watch,
northeast winds 20 to 30 knots with gusts up to 35 knots and
seas 8 to 13 feet possible.

* WHERE...Flagler Beach to Volusia-Brevard County Line 0-20 nm
and Volusia-Brevard County Line to Sebastian Inlet 0-20 nm.

* WHEN...For the Small Craft Advisory, from 2 PM this afternoon
to 8 PM EDT Saturday. For the Gale Watch, from Saturday
evening through Sunday evening.

* IMPACTS...Strong winds can cause hazardous seas which could
capsize or damage vessels and reduce visibility.
items.instruction:
Mariners should consider altering plans to avoid possible
hazardous conditions.  Remain in port, seek safe harbor, alter
course, and/or secure the vessel for severe wind and seas.
